description.value: My Name Is Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on Jacklin Road in Langford offering a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, nigiri, maki, teriyaki, udon, donburi, and bento boxes. The restaurant supports online ordering with pickup, delivery, and dine-in options, and has been noted for gluten-free sushi options. It is a neighbourhood spot in the Westshore area of Greater Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page provides the authoritative address (3194 Jacklin Road, Langford BC V9B 5J9) and phone (250-474-7888), neither of which appear in the OSM record. The online ordering page confirms pickup/takeout is available and the blog mentions gluten-free sushi. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Victoria' but the website address is Langford (a separate municipality); OSM coordinates appear consistent with the Langford Jacklin Road location.
Online ordering page renders the address as 'Victoria BC V9B 5J9' while the contact page says 'Langford B.C V9B 5J9' — minor internal inconsistency on the website itself.
Phone and address were absent from OSM; sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant with takeout and GF options, useful to touring cyclists for a meal stop, but none of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence — a site visit or direct contact is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Blog post titled 'Gluten Free Sushi' confirms gluten-free options are available; vegetarian/vegan status not explicitly stated
